text: Family's Light! You taught the check, not just the answer.
tr: Family's Light! Itinuro mo ang pag-check, hindi lang ang sagot.

text: Almost ordered
tr: Muntik nang umorder

text: Lola did not buy the capsule, but the video made it to a few other groups, or Lola felt scolded. A calm, early check keeps everyone closer.
tr: Hindi bumili ng capsule si Lola, pero umabot ang video sa ilang ibang grupo, o nasermunan si Lola. Ang kalmado at maagang pag-check ay nagpapalapit sa lahat.

text: Lola, do not buy it. Let me look at your knees at the health center.
tr: Lola, huwag ninyong bilhin. Tingnan ko ang mga tuhod ninyo sa health center.

text: Okay, Jun. Thank you.
tr: Okay, Jun. Salamat.

text: So close! Kind and early is the combo.
tr: Muntik na! Mabait at maaga ang kombinasyon.

text: The order goes through
tr: Natuloy ang order

text: Lola sent money to the shop and the bottles never came. The family is sad but safe. Kuya Jun helped them report the shop, and Lola will see a real doctor about her knees.
tr: Nagpadala ng pera si Lola sa shop at hindi dumating ang mga bote. Malungkot pero ligtas ang pamilya. Tinulungan sila ni Kuya Jun na i-report ang shop, at magpapatingin si Lola sa tunay na doktor para sa mga tuhod niya.

text: Let us report the shop and keep your messages. If someone asks for money, call the cybercrime hotline, 1326.
tr: I-report natin ang shop at itago ang mga mensahe ninyo. Kung may humingi ng pera, tawagan ang cybercrime hotline, 1326.

text: Sorry, dear. I trusted the video.
tr: Sorry, anak. Nagtiwala ako sa video.

text: A faked video can fool anyone. We still have a way to fix it. Try again?
tr: Kayang lokohin ng pekeng video ang kahit sino. May paraan pa rin tayo para ayusin ito. Subukan ulit?

text: Family GC, rainy afternoon
tr: Family GC, maulang hapon

text: One person's story is not proof. A cough that lasts 2 weeks or more should be checked by a health worker, and a home remedy can delay that check.
tr: Hindi patunay ang kuwento ng isang tao. Dapat ipasuri sisang health worker ang ubo na tumatagal nang 2 linggo o higit pa, at puwedeng maantala ng gamot sa bahay ang pag-check na iyon.

text: CONTENT_GUIDE section 3: a cough lasting two weeks or more should be checked for TB; TB is curable and treatment is free at health centers. Section 4 (Kwento Kim).
tr: CONTENT_GUIDE section 3: dapat ipa-check sa TB ang ubo na tumatagal nang dalawang linggo o higit pa; nagagamot ang TB at libre ang gamutan sa mga health center. Section 4 (Kwento Kim).

text: Aling Cora was coughing for 3 months. She drank garlic tea and skipped the health center. SHE GOT WELL! Try it! 🙏
tr: 3 buwang inubo si Aling Cora. Uminom siya ng garlic tea at hindi pumunta sa health center. GUMALING SIYA! Subukan ninyo! 🙏

text: Papa has coughed for three weeks. Maybe we try the garlic tea first?
tr: Tatlong linggo nang inuubo si Papa. Baka puwede muna nating subukan ang garlic tea?

text: Bea's father has had a cough for three weeks. What do you do?
tr: Tatlong linggo nang inuubo ang tatay ni Bea. Ano ang gagawin mo?

text: React with ❤️
tr: Mag-react ng ❤️

text: A kind reaction, but it also cheers on the garlic tea, and Papa still has a cough.
tr: Mabait na reaksyon, pero pinapalakpakan din nito ang garlic tea, at inuubo pa rin si Papa.

text: Ask where this story came from
tr: Itanong kung saan galing ang kuwentong ito

text: Tita, who is Aling Cora? Where did you hear this?
tr: Tita, sino si Aling Cora? Saan ninyo ito narinig?

text: A friendly question, with no blame. You found that it is a story with no name or date.
tr: Magiliw na tanong, walang sisihan. Natuklasan mong kuwento itong walang pangalan o petsa.

text: Who told this story?
tr: Sino ang nagkuwento nito?

text: Name
tr: Pangalan

text: "A neighbour of a friend of Tita's friend"
tr: "Kapitbahay ng kaibigan ng kaibigan ni Tita"

text: Date and place
tr: Petsa at lugar

text: None given
tr: Walang ibinigay

text: Evidence
tr: Ebidensya

text: One story. No health worker is mentioned.
tr: Isang kuwento. Walang binanggit nisang health worker.

text: One passed-along story is not evidence. It could be true, and it could be one lucky case.
tr: Hindi ebidensya ang isang kuwentong ipinasa-pasa. Puwedeng totoo ito, at puwedeng isang masuwerteng kaso lang.

text: Ask Kuya Jun about a long cough
tr: Tanungin si Kuya Jun tungkol sa matagal na ubo

text: Kuya Jun, is it okay to treat a long cough with garlic tea?
tr: Kuya Jun, okay lang bang gamutin ang matagal na ubo ng garlic tea?

text: Asking a real person you can trust is Step 2 at its best.
tr: Ang pagtatanong sa tunay na taong mapagkakatiwalaan ang pinakamahusay na Hakbang 2.

text: Ask Kuya Jun
tr: Tanungin si Kuya Jun

text: Question
tr: Tanong

text: Can garlic tea cure a long cough?
tr: Napapagaling ba ng garlic tea ang matagal na ubo?

text: Kuya Jun says
tr: Sabi ni Kuya Jun

text: A cough that lasts 2 weeks or more should be checked at the health center for TB.
tr: Ang ubo na tumatagal nang 2 linggo o higit pa ay dapat ipa-check sa health center para sa TB.

text: Good news
tr: Magandang balita

text: TB can be cured with complete treatment, and it is free at the health center.
tr: Nagagamot ang TB kapag kumpleto ang gamutan, at libre ito sa health center.

text: A long cough needs a health worker, not a home remedy.
tr: Health worker ang kailangan ng matagal na ubo, hindi gamot sa bahay.

text: Forward the story to the Barangay Moms group
tr: I-forward ang kuwento sa Barangay Moms group

text: A story that tells people to skip the health center is risky to spread. Accuracy 0.
tr: Mapanganib ipakalat ang kuwentong nagsasabi sa mga tao na huwag pumunta sa health center. Accuracy 0.

text: "Tita, a story is not proof. That is dangerous!"
tr: "Tita, hindi patunay ang kuwento. Delikado iyan!"

text: Tita, one story is not proof. That is dangerous advice!
tr: Tita, hindi patunay ang isang kuwento. Delikadong payo iyan!

text: Right idea, but you have not checked, and it is said sharply.
tr: Tamang ideya, pero hindi ka pa nakapag-check, at matalim ang pagkakasabi.

text: So... should Papa go to the health center?
tr: Kaya... dapat bang pumunta si Papa sa health center?

text: But Aling Cora really got better! I only wanted to help.
tr: Pero talagang gumaling si Aling Cora! Gusto ko lang tumulong.

text: I can see Papa any weekday.
tr: Makikita ko si Papa kahit anong araw ng linggo.

text: You checked. How do you answer Tita and Bea?
tr: Nag-check ka. Paano ka sasagot kay Tita at Bea?

text: "Tita, I love that you want to help! A story is nice, but a cough of 3 weeks needs a check. Bea, please bring Papa to Kuya Jun. The TB test is free."
tr: "Tita, natutuwa akong gusto ninyong tumulong! Maganda ang kuwento, pero ang ubong 3 linggo na ay kailangan ng check. Bea, pakidala si Papa kay Kuya Jun. Libre ang TB test."

text: Tita, I love that you want to help! A story is nice, but a cough of 3 weeks needs a check. Bea, please bring Papa to Kuya Jun at the health center. The tests are free.
tr: Tita, natutuwa akong gusto ninyong tumulong! Maganda ang kuwento, pero ang ubong 3 linggo na ay kailangan ng check. Bea, pakidala si Papa kay Kuya Jun sa health center. Libre ang mga test.

text: Warm, specific and with a free next step. No one is blamed.
tr: Mainit, tiyak at may libreng susunod na hakbang. Walang sinisisi.

text: Share the story again with "NOT PROOF!" on top
tr: I-share ulit ang kuwento na may "HINDI PATUNAY!" sa itaas

text: Forwarded again: NOT PROOF! DO NOT TRY!
tr: Na-forward ulit: HINDI PATUNAY! HUWAG SUBUKAN!

text: Sharing the story again keeps it travelling. Share what the health worker said instead.
tr: Pinapagalaw pa rin ng pag-share muli ng kuwento ito. Ibahagi na lang ang sinabi ng health worker.

text: "Tita, stop spreading stories that can hurt people."
tr: "Tita, tigilan na ang pagkakalat ng mga kuwentong makakasakit ng tao."

text: Tita, stop spreading stories that can hurt people.
tr: Tita, tigilan na ang pagkakalat ng mga kuwentong makakasakit ng tao.

text: Right about the risk, but it blames Tita instead of helping her.
tr: Tama ka sa panganib, pero sinisisi nito si Tita sa halip na tulungan siya.

text: Thanks, Ate! I will buy garlic tonight and make Papa drink tea.
tr: Salamat, Ate! Bibili ako ng bawang mamayang gabi at pauunumin si Papa ng tsaa.

text: Hello. Is somebody coughing for a long time?
tr: Hello. May matagal bang inuubo diyan?

text: Bea will try the tea instead of the health center. Step in?
tr: Susubukan ni Bea ang tsaa sa halip na pumunta sa health center. Pipigilan mo?

text: Say "Wait, Bea!" and ask Kuya Jun
tr: Sabihing "Teka, Bea!" at tanungin si Kuya Jun

text: Wait, Bea! Let us ask Kuya Jun first.
tr: Teka, Bea! Tanungin muna natin si Kuya Jun.

text: Good. You stopped the delay before it started.
tr: Mabuti. Napigilan mo ang pagkaantala bago ito nagsimula.

text: "Sorry, Bea, my ❤️ was only for Tita. Please take Papa to the health center for a check first."
tr: "Sorry, Bea, para kay Tita lang ang ❤️ ko. Pakidala muna si Papa sa health center para magpa-check."

text: Sorry Bea, my ❤️ was for Tita, not for the tea. Please take Papa to the health center for a check first.
tr: Sorry Bea, para kay Tita ang ❤️ ko, hindi para sa tsaa. Pakidala muna si Papa sa health center para magpa-check.

text: An honest correction with a clear next step.
tr: Tapat na pagtatama na may malinaw na susunod na hakbang.

text: Send another ❤️ and stay quiet
tr: Magpadala ng isa pang ❤️ at manahimik

text: No correction was made. Papa's check is delayed.
tr: Walang naging pagtatama. Naantala ang check ni Papa.

text: Ate, two moms in that group said they will skip the health center too.
tr: Ate, dalawang nanay sa grupong iyon ang nagsabing lalaktawan din nila ang health center.

text: I saw the Aling Cora story in the Moms group. Please check before you forward.
tr: Nakita ko ang kuwento ni Aling Cora sa Moms group. Paki-check bago mag-forward.

text: Your forward told people to skip the health center. What now?
tr: Sinabi ng forward mo sa mga tao na huwag pumunta sa health center. Ano ngayon?

text: Ask Kuya Jun, then post a kind correction
tr: Tanungin si Kuya Jun, tapos mag-post ng mabait na pagtatama

text: Sorry, I forwarded this too fast. Kuya Jun says a cough of 2 weeks or more should be checked at the health center, and the tests are free. Please go.
tr: Sorry, masyado kong mabilis na na-forward ito. Sabi ni Kuya Jun, ang ubo na 2 linggo o higit pa ay dapat ipa-check sa health center, at libre ang mga test. Pakiusap, pumunta kayo.

text: A clear, kind correction. Some moms already saw the first post.
tr: Malinaw at mabait na pagtatama. May mga nanay nang nakakita ng unang post.

text: Say "Oh, sorry" and nothing else
tr: Sabihing "Naku, sorry" at wala nang iba

text: Oh, sorry.
tr: Naku, sorry.

text: Without the correction, people still believe the story.
tr: Kapag walang pagtatama, naniniwala pa rin ang mga tao sa kuwento.

text: Forward it to another group to be safe
tr: I-forward sa ibang grupo para sigurado

text: More shares mean more people who may skip their check-up.
tr: Mas maraming share, mas maraming taong baka mag-skip ng check-up nila.

text: Oh... I only meant to help Bea's Papa. 😢
tr: Naku... gusto ko lang tulungan ang Papa ni Bea. 😢

text: Ate, please be gentle. But is it safe or not?
tr: Ate, dahan-dahan naman. Pero ligtas ba o hindi?

text: Let us talk calmly.
tr: Mag-usap tayo nang kalmado.

text: You spoke sharply before you checked. Repair it?
tr: Matalim ang pagsasalita mo bago ka nag-check. Ayusin ito?

text: "Sorry, Tita, I was sharp. Thank you for wanting to help! I asked: a cough of 3 weeks should be checked at the health center."
tr: "Sorry, Tita, naging matalim ako. Salamat sa pagnanais na tumulong! Nagtanong ako: ang ubong 3 linggo ay dapat ipa-check sa health center."

text: Sorry Tita, I was sharp. Thank you for wanting to help! I asked: a cough of 3 weeks should be checked at the health center.
tr: Sorry Tita, naging matalim ako. Salamat sa pagnanais na tumulong! Nagtanong ako: ang ubong 3 linggo ay dapat ipa-check sa health center.

text: A real sorry, then the right advice. Tita and Bea both feel heard.
tr: Tunay na sorry, tapos ang tamang payo. Naririnig sina Tita at Bea.

text: Ask Kuya Jun together in the chat
tr: Sabay na magtanong kay Kuya Jun sa chat

text: Let us ask Kuya Jun together. Is it okay to treat a long cough at home?
tr: Sabay nating tanungin si Kuya Jun. Okay lang bang gamutin sa bahay ang matagal na ubo?

text: Asking together turns the quarrel into teamwork.
tr: Ang sabay na pagtatanong ay ginagawang pagtutulungan ang away.

text: "I said it is dangerous. Just trust me."
tr: "Sinabi kong delikado iyan. Magtiwala na lang kayo sa akin."

text: I said it is dangerous. Just trust me.
tr: Sinabi kong delikado iyan. Magtiwala na lang kayo sa akin.

text: No reason given, and Tita is still hurt. Bea may try the tea anyway.
tr: Walang dahilang ibinigay, at nasasaktan pa rin si Tita. Baka subukan pa rin ni Bea ang tsaa.

text: Papa gets checked
tr: Naka-check si Papa

text: You kept it kind and specific. Bea takes Papa to the health center this week, and Tita learns to ask "who says so?" before she shares.
tr: Pinanatili mong mabait at tiyak. Dinadala ni Bea si Papa sa health center ngayong linggo, at natututo si Tita na magtanong ng "sino ang nagsabi?" bago mag-share.

text: We are going to the health center on Monday. Thank you, Ate!
tr: Pupunta kami sa health center sa Lunes. Salamat, Ate!

text: Thank you, dear. I will not forward stories like that anymore. ❤️
tr: Salamat, anak. Hindi na ako magfo-forward ng ganoong mga kuwento. ❤️

text: Family's Light! A free check beats a nice story.
tr: Family's Light! Mas mabuti ang libreng check kaysa sa magandang kuwento.

text: Caught in time
tr: Nahuli sa tamang oras

text: Papa will get checked, but Tita felt hurt, or the story reached a few other groups first. A calm early check would have kept it smoother.
tr: Magpapa-check si Papa, pero nasaktan si Tita, o umabot ang kuwento sa ilang ibang grupo muna. Mas maayos sana ang kalmado at maagang pag-check.

text: Bea, bring Papa to the health center. The tests are free. See you!
tr: Bea, dalhin si Papa sa health center. Libre ang mga test. Kita tayo!

text: Okay, sorry for the trouble.
tr: Okay, sorry sa abala.

text: So close! A calm, early check keeps everyone close.
tr: Muntik na! Ang kalmado at maagang pag-check ay nagpapanatiling malapit ang lahat.

text: The check is delayed
tr: Naantala ang check

text: Papa kept coughing and drank garlic tea for two more weeks. Kuya Jun finally persuaded him to go to the health center. Nobody is to blame, but the delay was avoidable.
tr: Patuloy na inubo si Papa at uminom ng garlic tea nang dalawa pang linggo. Sa wakas ay napapayag siya ni Kuya Jun na pumunta sa health center. Walang dapat sisihin, pero naiwasan sana ang pagkaantala.

text: Let us get Papa checked this week. Please remember: 2 weeks or more of coughing needs a check.
tr: Ipa-check natin si Papa ngayong linggo. Tandaan: ang ubo na 2 linggo o higit pa ay kailangan ng check.

text: Sorry, Papa. We should have gone sooner.
tr: Sorry, Papa. Dapat mas maaga tayong pumunta.

text: It is not your fault, friend. One story felt convincing. Try again?
tr: Hindi mo kasalanan, kaibigan. Nakakukumbinsi ang isang kuwento. Subukan ulit?

text: Free Vaccines
tr: Libreng Bakuna

text: Family GC, Monday morning
tr: Family GC, umaga ng Lunes

text: This one is TRUE. A named health center, a date, a clear place and nothing to sell. Calibrated trust means checking, then saying "this one is legit" and acting on it.
tr: TOTOO ang isang ito. May pinangalanang health center, petsa, malinaw na lugar at walang ibinebenta. Ang matalinong pagtitiwala ay ang pag-check, tapos pagsasabing "legit ito" at pagkilos batay rito.

text: CONTENT_GUIDE section 3: routine childhood vaccines are available free at health centers. Section 1: calibrated trust, never "trust nothing".
tr: CONTENT_GUIDE section 3: libre ang mga karaniwang bakuna ng bata sa mga health center. Section 1: matalinong pagtitiwala, hindi "huwag magtiwala sa kahit ano".

text: Barangay Sampaguita Health Center: FREE vaccines for children every Wednesday, 8 to 11 AM. Bring the vaccine card. Walk-ins welcome. Please share with the moms! 🙏
tr: Barangay Sampaguita Health Center: LIBRENG bakuna para sa mga bata tuwing Miyerkules, 8 hanggang 11 AM. Dalhin ang vaccine card. Welcome ang walk-in. Paki-share sa mga nanay! 🙏

text: My grandchild is due for her shots! Should we go on Wednesday?
tr: Panahon na para sa bakuna ng apo ko! Pupunta ba tayo sa Miyerkules?

text: Hmm, "free" and "please share"... sounds like a hoax to me.
tr: Hmm, "libre" at "paki-share"... parang hoax sa akin.

text: Is this a hoax or the real thing? What do you do?
tr: Hoax ba ito o totoo? Ano ang gagawin mo?

text: A kind reaction, and it happens to be true, but you did not check. Next time, check first.
tr: Mabait na reaksyon, at nagkataong totoo, pero hindi ka nag-check. Sa susunod, mag-check muna.

text: Let me look at who posted this.
tr: Tingnan ko kung sino ang nag-post nito.

text: You checked and did not just guess. That is the habit.
tr: Nag-check ka at hindi lang hinulaan. Iyan ang gawi.
